canonical.title: Weekend in Larrabetzu: Michelin Dinner + Basque Country

sources.claim: Azurmendi holds 3 Michelin stars; picnic by vertical garden, snacks in kitchen corridor
Adarrak €315 / Gran Menú €350 (VAT in); wine pairing €150 or €300; Tue–Sat lunch, Fri–Sat dinner
Eneko Atxa runs Azurmendi (★★★) and ENEKO Larrabetzu (★) plus global outposts
Sutan tasting menu €96 (VAT in); Wed–Sun lunch, Fri–Sat dinner; Barrio Legina s/n
Hamaiketako experience: 4 txakoli wines + Idiazábal, ham, gilda pintxo — €30 p.p., daily 11:00
Gorka Izagirre winery at same address as Azurmendi and Eneko; 15 min from Bilbao
Azurmendi: bioclimatic glass building on hilltop beside Bilbao Airport; 4.7/5 (1,346 reviews)
Church of San Emeterio y San Celedonio: Gothic with Bizkaia's 2nd-ranked Hispano-Flemish altarpiece
Larrabetzu: founded 1376, rebuilt neoclassical after 1830 fire, Conjunto Monumental since 1994
Azurmendi LEED Gold; World's Most Sustainable Restaurant 2014 and 2018; geothermal + solar
Azurmendi #49 World's 50 Best 2021; Highest Climber Award 2019 (+29 places)
Eneko Atxa opened Azurmendi 2005; 3rd star 2012 (first in Biscay); National Gastronomy Award 2016
Guggenheim Bilbao: Tue–Sun 10:00–19:00; adult €15; free Tuesdays 18:00–20:00
San Juan de Gaztelugatxe: free timed ticket required; daily cap 1,462; auto-cancel 60 min after slot
Tickets mandatory Jun 10–Sep 15 daily and spring/autumn weekends; cancellable up to 2h before
Gernika Peace Museum: €6.50 / €4.50 reduced; free Sat afternoons; 1h30 suggested
Bermeo: marmitako harbour town; Gaztelugatxe = Dragonstone (Game of Thrones)
Azurmendi has no walkable transit access; taxi ~25–35 euros from Bilbao centre
Bizkaibus A3223 links Bilbao–Larrabetzu ~hourly; fare ~€1.50 occasional / €0.57 with card
Best window: June–mid-September (warmest, driest); November and April rainiest
Bizkargi loop from Alto de Morga: ~8 km, topped by Santakrutz hermitage
Artxanda funicular: €6 return; every 15 min; 3-min ride to hilltop views
Gernika weekly Monday market; Casa de Juntas and Tree of Gernika free to visit
Bilbao–Gaztelugatxe ~45 min; Gaztelugatxe–Bermeo ~30 min; Bermeo–Gernika ~30 min
Azkuna Zentroa (Philippe Starck): free entry; 43 distinctive columns; rooftop terrace; Mon–Sat
Gernika: Casa de Juntas, Peace Museum, Euskal Herria Museum cluster around Plaza de los Fueros
Mundaka: legendary left-hand river-mouth wave inside Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve
Castillo de Butrón: Bavarian-model fairytale castle rebuilt 1878 near Mungia
